integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the exact published Bloch secular equation. Numerical replay is used only as a finite consistency check and is not treated as a proof of the asymptotic statement.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotics hold for fixed \(0<\mu<\pi/2\) and are not uniform at the two endpoint couplings. No coefficient beyond the \(O(n^{-2})\) edge remainder is claimed, and negative-spectrum behavior is outside scope.
title: Sharp two-band high-energy scaling for the phase-rotated square quantum graph
